# HiveVault

> Self-hosted memory server for a company. Documents stay on the company server; local models compile them into linked Markdown pages with citations. A cloud agent reads compiled pages classified `pubblico` (public) or `interno` (internal) through an MCP server using an API key.

## Connect

- MCP (streamable HTTP, stateless): `POST /mcp` with header `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`. API accounts only; the administrator grants vaults and scopes.
- REST API for documents: `/api/vaults`, `/api/vaults/{id}/sources` (upload), `/api/sources/{id}` (status), `/api/search`, `/api/pages/{id}`.

## MCP tools

- `brain_overview`: vaults, page counts, coverage, recent pages. Call it first.
- `brain_search`: hybrid search with filters; returns IDs, summaries, snippets with citations, and token costs.
- `brain_read`: reads a page or document within a token budget; current state first.
- `brain_neighbors`: links and backlinks, up to 2 hops.
- `brain_timeline`: dated events for an entity or across vaults in a time range.
- `brain_source`: extracted text of a citation `^[src_…#cN]`. Original files never leave the server.
- `brain_ask`: short answer synthesized by the local model, with citations.
- `brain_capture`: saves a note in the inbox of a writable vault (requires `write` scope).
- `brain_journal`: work journal. `"leggi"` (read) retrieves recent session and daily notes; `"sessione"` (session) and `"giornata"` (day) write a note (Done / Decided / Open) into the inbox linked to existing pages (requires `write` scope).
- `brain_propose_edit`: proposes a page edit for human approval (requires `write` scope).

## Resources and prompts

- Resources: `brain://{vault}/index`, `brain://{vault}/llms.txt`, `brain://{vault}/page/{id}`
- Prompts: `cosa-sappiamo-di`, `stato-cliente`, `prepara-riunione`

## Rules

- Cite every fact with the ID returned by the tools.
- Pages classified `riservato` (confidential), `segreto` (secret), or `personale` (personal) are never returned to API accounts.
- A missing answer means "not in memory or not visible to this account".
